objective: Train the internally routed recurrent-value RWKV bottleneck on the same locked schedule as the addressed-value runs, excluding the provably read-inert projected router from optimization, before measuring native causal margins.

failed_preflight_v1.observed_exception: RuntimeError: Addressed causal optimizer has inactive parameters
failed_preflight_v1.diagnosis: The complete projected bundle is causally inert in recurrent_value mode, but v1 still included each layer's projected_kv_key_proj in the optimizer.

trainable_isolation.reason: This parameter family only constructs a projected carrier that recurrent_value does not read.

training.distribution: two rows per rank with explicitly summed gradients
training.positive_objective: native scene answer cross-entropy with correct internally routed recurrent state
training.intervention_invariant: The complete projected key, value, occupancy, and surprise bundle remains the correct-row tensors for donor and layer-permuted controls even though it is read-inert.
training.hinge: max(0, margin + CE_correct - CE_control) for each causal control
training.checkpoint_selection: none; evaluate only the fixed update-8 endpoint

next_evaluation_if_passed.source: The already-open 220-row publisher-TRAIN-derived development partition only.

stopping_rule.preflight: Run exactly one update first; launch update-8 training only if every preflight gate passes.
stopping_rule.training_pass: Authorize only the locked already-open 220-row native development evaluation.
stopping_rule.training_failure: Block evaluation and archive the failure.
stopping_rule.always: Archive, commit, and push the result.

claim_policy.training_pass: May claim causal-contrast optimization completed and recurrent controls were structurally fixed during training.
claim_policy.native_gain: Forbidden until the separately analyzed generation evaluation passes all four native micro-F1 margins.
claim_policy.protected_replication: Forbidden without a new preregistered protocol.
